name: TRAVERSE
scope: Isolated static prototype. No production token changes.
principle: A steady navigation rail anchors a warm analytical canvas. Source, question, result and explicit save form one horizontal progression. Data and provenance carry the hierarchy.

layout.navigationRail: 184px, deep forest, sticky desktop, primary navigation above distinct account utility area
layout.canvas: Warm off-white, 38px desktop padding, maximum main width 1420px
layout.analysis: Horizontal Source → Question → Résultat → Enregistrer sequence, compact source ribbon, progressive parameter form, broad result stage, plot and exact aggregate table side by side
layout.dashboard: Compact real filter toolbar, asymmetric 1.65:1 mean/count layout, full-width quality strip
layout.assistant: Conversation-centered content with 286px evidence rail; presentation, date, recorded price and source visible without opening a disclosure
layout.surfaceGrammar: Flat tonal grouping. Rounded corners reserved for controls, result stages, messages and dialogs. No gradients or decorative side strips.

responsive.behavior: Analysis exact table moves below chart; forms use two columns; dashboard and evidence columns tighten.
Forest rail becomes a compact top band; primary navigation is a second horizontal row; account utility remains separate; 22px canvas padding.
Single-column forms and widgets; conversation above evidence; 17px canvas padding; journey retains four compact sequence steps; explicit horizontal scrolling for the wide exact table.

responsive.status: Central visual QA delegated to root; this document makes no rendering claim.

button.disabled: Pale neutral, muted text, unavailable cursor
button.loading: Use a stable label and disable repeat action; skeleton specimen is in system view
button.error: Field-level or adjacent recovery copy; no unexplained icon

navigation.selected: Sage fill and forest label, aria-current page
navigation.dirtyLeave: Native dialog with Rester or Abandonner et quitter only; Escape keeps in-page values

inputs.default: Native labels, selects and textarea; 44px height
inputs.disabled: Measured-column selector unavailable for row count
inputs.error: aria-invalid and human recovery instruction; empty assistant question blocks submission
inputs.loading: Retain values while pending; no automatic replay

journey.selected: Forest underline and solid numbered marker
journey.interaction: Source opens source dialog; Question reveals parameters; Result scrolls to valid stage or announces recalculation; Enregistrer opens explicit simulation

result.ready: Chart, exact table, denominator, source and method
result.stale: Result removed and explicit recalculate notice
result.empty: Choose rules then calculate instruction in system specimen
result.chartTabs: Keyboard arrows/Home/End, selected ARIA tab, named panels

dashboard.filtered: Precomputed all/A/B presets update means visibility, row counts, percentages and price missingness together
dashboard.inspect: Named native dialog with exact values and scope
dashboard.edit: Memory-only width change and clearly announced movement specimen
dashboard.readOnly: Normal mode has no arrangement handles
dashboard.unavailable: Disabled state vocabulary retained; no live source availability emulated

assistant.source: Evidence rail with readable identity/presentation/source/date, expandable provenance
assistant.submit: Typed text rendered as text nodes; local two-box or provenance fixture response, otherwise announced service simulation
assistant.error: Empty question is labeled and focus returns to composer
assistant.reset: Clears only in-memory local conversation and announces no server invalidation
assistant.expiry: Product's 30-minute behavior explained; no expiry or persistence falsely emulated

dialogs.default: Native modal dialog, twelve-pixel corners, neutral elevation
dialogs.unsaved: Only Stay and Discard actions; no recovery persistence

notices.info: Forest toast with polite live region
notices.error: Brick on pale brick, text describes recovery

motion.purpose: Only result geometry changes after an explicit fixture calculation
motion.reducedMotion: All animation and transition disabled; result navigation uses immediate scrolling
motion.entrance: No page-load choreography; complete content visible immediately

prototype.storage: None. State is JavaScript memory only.
prototype.network: None. No dependencies, fetch, XHR, service workers or remote assets.
prototype.save: Announced simulation; never clears dirty state or claims a persisted save
prototype.data: Synthetic CP6 v1 and provided ABIP responses.json fixture, explicitly labeled
prototype.verification: No browser run by candidate author; root owns visual and interaction QA.

tradeoffs: Progressive parameters make results easier to read but add one reveal before editing the full configuration.
The rail consumes 184px on desktop, giving stable cross-view navigation and a separate account area.
The assistant evidence column keeps provenance nearby but moves below the conversation on narrow displays.

success.behavior: Persistent contextual text naming the confirmed operation and saved revision; never inferred from Calculate or a local simulation

warning.behavior: Explicit consequence and next action, color accompanied by text

validation.behavior: Linked summary and field-specific instruction; aria-invalid and aria-describedby; retain current input

proposedFeedback.unknownOutcome: Explain uncertainty; read-only verification before explicit retry, no automatic mutation replay

proposedChartSystem.continuousScale: Light neutral through the primary data hue; explicit numeric legend and units
proposedChartSystem.redundancy: Text labels, line dashes/point markers and exact tables; do not rely on hue alone
proposedChartSystem.scope: Proposal for all existing chart types; the HTML specimens demonstrate bars only, plus exact tables/missingness. No production palette adopted.

centralVerification: REVIEW.md, browser-verification.json and review-verification.json; candidate remains unapproved
